points.description: Names the two modes of control plane distribution: replication and partitioning (both must be named).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only one mode is named correctly.

points.description: Gives one valid downside for each mode: for replication, e.g. scalability issue, extra resources/cost, standby wastage with no load distribution, or hard data consistency; for partitioning, e.g. P2P-like issues, neighbourhood knowledge, coordination/consistency, or lower availability.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if a valid downside is given for only one mode, or if downsides are vague.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both modes named (replication, partitioning) and one correct downside for each. Give part marks when only one mode or one downside is correct, or when a downside is vague. A downside is only credited if it fits the mode it is attached to; give no marks for wrong modes or generic statements.
